prep_script.empty: The script planned nothing. Only plan(tool, args) has any effect.
prep_script.failed: {index}. {tool} FAILED: {error} — stopped here; earlier operations stand.
prep_script.invalid: The script could not produce a plan: {error}
prep_script.source_usage: Give exactly one of script (inline JavaScript) or script_ref (an installed pack's script, e.g. "packid/prep/setup.js").
prep_script.ref_not_found: No installed pack script at "{ref}" — check the pack id and path (.import-style pack-relative reference).
prep_script.preview:
Planned {count} operation(s) — nothing has run yet. Call again with apply=true to carry them out.
{operations}
prep_script.unavailable: The plan cannot be applied here: this room has no toolset bound.
prep_script.unreachable: This plan names tools that cannot be reached here: {tools}. Nothing was applied — a plan is validated whole, so it never runs half of itself.
